definitions.explanation: Joining or linking things together, especially physical objects like train cars. Also used in business for consolidated financial statements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{連結|れんけつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十|じゅう}{両|りょう}{連結|れんけつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運行|うんこう}→運行：14375_unkou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This train runs with ten cars connected together.

examples.japanese: {連結|れんけつ}⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{子会社|こがいしゃ}→子会社：12258_kogaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{含|ふく}めた→含める：02408_fukumeru⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{財務|ざいむ}→財務：05971_zaimu⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わかる。
examples.english: Consolidated financial statements show the overall financial situation including subsidiary performance.

notes:
USAGE:
{連結|れんけつ} is used in two main domains: transportation (coupling train cars) and business/finance (consolidated accounting).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連結|れんけつ}⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧ (consolidated financial statements)
- {連結|れんけつ}⟦{売上高|うりあげだか}→売上高：12376_uriagedaka⟧ (consolidated revenue)
- ⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連結|れんけつ} (coupling of train cars)
- {連結|れんけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}する→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧ (to uncouple, to disconnect)
- {連結|れんけつ}⟦{子会社|こがいしゃ}→子会社：12258_kogaisha⟧ (consolidated subsidiary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{接続|せつぞく}→接続：04367_setsuzoku⟧ (connection) is used for more general connections (internet, transport transfers). {連結|れんけつ} implies a physical or organizational joining together.
